headline: Indian Equities Post Strongest Weekly Gains in Over a Year Amid Foreign Inflows
summary: The Nifty and Sensex logged their strongest weekly gains in over a year, climbing more than 8% driven by positive global cues, strong domestic fundamentals, and a sharp turnaround in foreign investor flows.
why: The Nifty 50 and BSE Sensex are India's premier equity benchmarks. Rebounding foreign portfolio inflows signal shifting global allocations toward domestic growth assets.

impacts.name: BSE Sensex
impacts.why: Benchmark equity index gained over 8% across the week driven by foreign inflows.
